visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a mauve tank top and black high-waisted leggings, sits on a wooden Pilates stability chair in a brightly lit studio. She smiles warmly at the camera while speaking. She performs a side lateral stretch, reaching one arm over her head while the other hand rests on the chair's pedal. The background is a professional studio with large windows showing green trees, multiple reformers, and a Cadillac machine. (2) The scene cuts to the woman lying prone on the stability chair. Her chest and hips are supported by the padded surface while her hands push down on the pedals. She lifts her legs straight behind her into a swan-like extension, demonstrating core and glute strength. The blue exercise ball is visible on the floor behind the chair, and the lighting remains bright and natural. (3) The woman is then seen on a Pilates Cadillac, hanging vertically upside down. Her feet are hooked into white fluffy straps at the top of the frame, and she uses her hands to guide her body through a deep inversion stretch. She maintains a controlled posture with her back arched. Large white subtitles appear at the bottom center of the frame throughout the movements.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你知道最貴的投資是什麼嗎. (2) [Subtitle]: 不是股票 不是房子 是你的身體. (3) [Subtitle]: 一旦身體垮了 你什麼都保不住. (4) [Subtitle]: 健康 是所有自由的底牌. (5) [Subtitle]: 照顧好自己 是女人最強的底氣. (6) [Subtitle]: 健康的女人 最珍貴哦. (7) [Subtitle]: 📍健康，是所有自由的起點.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to motivate female viewers to prioritize their health by framing physical well-being as the most valuable investment. It uses Pilates demonstrations to visually represent self-care and strength.
